resources.string: Togetherly stores everything only on this device. You can remove specific data below, or delete everything and start over.
Removes photos, voice recordings, and notes attached to completed quests. Quest history itself, saved quests, and your family profile are kept.
This permanently deletes every photo, voice recording, and note attached to your completed quests. This can\'t be undone.\n\nQuest history, saved quests, and your family profile are kept.
Clears today\'s quest, dismissed quests, and every completed quest along with its memories. Saved quests and your family profile are kept.
This permanently clears today\'s quest, dismissed quests, and every completed quest along with its memories. This can\'t be undone.\n\nSaved quests and your family profile are kept.
Permanently deletes everything Togetherly has stored on this device and returns to setup. This does not cancel a Family Plus subscription or delete your purchase history.

This permanently deletes your family profile, preferences, quest history, memories, and every photo and voice recording stored on this device. This can't be undone.

A Family Plus subscription is managed separately through the App Store or Google Play — this does not cancel it.

Afterward, the app returns to setup.
Done, but some files couldn\'t be removed and may need to be cleared manually.
